title: Find a booking as a guest (reference + last name)
caption: bookings.lookup (src/bookings/guest-access.service.ts, lookup.controller.ts). Limit: 5 failures per 15 minutes per IP and per reference. The guest token handed out at checkout lasts 30 days or until 7 days after the last flight, whichever is later.

steps.title: Open the lookup page
steps.body: Type the booking reference (VX + 6 characters, from the confirmation e-mail) or the airline record locator, and the last name of any traveller (case- and accent-insensitive).
steps.expect: `POST /v1/bookings/lookup {bookingReference, lastName}` → `200` BookingSummary; a `booking_access_tokens` row (`issued_via = lookup`, 24 h), staff-only event `booking.lookup`, and cookie `__Host-vx_bt` (HttpOnly, up to five tokens, newest first; key callers get `bookingToken` in the body). Only bookings of the storefront environment that are not `failed` are found.

steps.title: Wrong name, wrong reference
steps.body: Try a wrong last name, then a wrong reference.
steps.expect: Every mismatch (unknown reference, wrong name, other environment, failed booking) answers the same `404 NOT_FOUND` with the same message: the answers differ only in `requestId`.

steps.title: Rate limit
steps.body: Fail five times from one IP within 15 minutes.

steps.title: What a guest may do
steps.body: Read the booking, documents, timeline; change contacts; quote and cancel when allowed.
steps.expect: Only this booking: another booking id with the same cookie → `404`. `allowedActions` says what is allowed and why not.
